column1: # Maps where Forever's map coordinates are not Classic's (Wowhead's Forever NPC positions are Classic's).
# Forever redrew Stormwind's map the way retail did (it takes in the harbour): the same places sit elsewhere in
# 0-100 map coordinates. Each line pairs one place's Wowhead (Classic) position with where it is in Forever,
# captured in game; tools/gen_pois.py fits a straight-line conversion per axis for each map from its pairs (two or
# more, spread out) and applies it to every Wowhead position on that map. Captured positions are left as they are.
